messages:
ryan: Vendor wants a single launch day for H100/H200 + MI300 + Gaudi. Gaudi certs might miss the window. Thoughts?
vendor-pm: Confirmed: H100/H200/MI300 tags ready Tue; Gaudi driver QA may slip 48h. Sharing manifest once tags live.
meera: Recommend internal embargo for all, but public messaging phased: announce partnership day 0, mark Gaudi as "limited preview" if it slips.
lucas: infra can gate marketplace by tag state. I'll prepare two states: LAUNCH and PREVIEW, and a fallback routing script.
infra-bot: Uploaded canary template CL-1022. Pending image tags to start smoke runs.
comm: PR prefers no ship dates; use "available in select regions at launch; additional SKUs to follow". Legal ok with "preview" language.yan: Action items: lucas implement gating & fallback; vendor-pm deliver image manifests; meera draft embargo + messaging; comm prepare holding statements. Reconvene Wed AM.
vendor-pm: Will post updates here if Gaudi slips.
meera: Also prepping an SI EAP path for Gaudi so partners can onboard early with stricter SLAs.
ryan: Good. If Gaudi slips >48h, we proceed with joint announce and tag Gaudi PREVIEW.
